title: NASA flight surgeon on Apollo astronauts shunning Edgar Mitchell
place_text: Aquarius underwater base off Key Largo

tellings.quote:
I was
diving on the Aquarius wath base with a
NASA flight surgeon Who Remain unnamed

plain: Other Apollo astronauts kept their distance from Edgar Mitchell, one of the men who walked on the Moon, according to a NASA flight surgeon (an astronaut's doctor) whom John Blitch, a former DARPA scientist, will not name. Blitch tells Michels the surgeon said this while the two were diving together in 2008 at Aquarius, an underwater research base off Key Largo, Florida, and he tells it as an inside glimpse of how Mitchell was treated by his own colleagues.
